title: Warehouse Transfer Tracking Log
subtitle: Warehouse Transfer: preserves changes and next triggers.
description: Warehouse Transfer Tracking Log covers inventory unit, source bin, destination bin, transfer order, handling unit, and posting. The inventory transfer coordinator records Warehouse Transfer events, owners, exceptions, and next triggers. Warehouse Transfer Tracking Log keeps Warehouse Transfer exceptions visible until the inventory transfer coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Warehouse Transfer Tracking Log at source warehouse, staging lane, vehicle or conveyance, and destination warehouse. Document inventory unit, source bin, destination bin, transfer order, handling unit, and posting identity before Warehouse Transfer begins. Compare inventory unit, source bin, destination bin, transfer order, handling unit, and posting findings with stated Warehouse Transfer criteria; route unresolved Warehouse Transfer issues to warehouse control reviewer.

sections.title: Tracking period and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Warehouse Transfer, identify responsible parties, source warehouse, staging lane, vehicle or conveyance, and destination warehouse, and the linked inventory unit, source bin, destination bin, transfer order, handling unit, and posting source.

fields.label: Item, lot, serial, quantity, and unit of measure
Source, destination, handling-unit, and seal identifiers

sections.title: Tracking review and variance evidence
sections.guidance: Capture Warehouse Transfer facts for inventory unit, source bin, destination bin, transfer order, handling unit, and posting; include result, limit, source, and next control.

sections.title: Current status outcome and next update
sections.guidance: For Warehouse Transfer, preserve each open variance with its current state, accountable owner, and next dated update. Inventory Transfer Coordinator performs period review.

blocks.label: Status exceptions, overdue actions, and retained evidence
items: Wrong item, lot, serial, or destination
blocks.guidance: Pause Warehouse Transfer when physical quantity, identity, custody, destination receipt, or system posting remains unresolved. Retain the available Warehouse Transfer proof and route unresolved inventory unit, source bin, destination bin, transfer order, handling unit, and posting scope to inventory transfer coordinator.
